newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Bratislava bourse slump continues, SAX off 0.58pts.
newsitem.headline: Bratislava bourse slump continues, SAX off 0.58pts.

text.p: Slovak shares opened the week slightly lower on Monday, as the official SAX index closed down 0.58 points at 168.92 in thin trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Monday.
A 1.6 percent loss to the average price of the most capitalised issue, oil refinery Slovnaft, though its shares closed up 10 crowns at 860, but on a volume of only four shares.
Steel maker VSZ traded 120 shares, the biggest volume matched on the bourse's listed floor on Monday, and closed unchanged at 633 crowns.
Dealers said a lack of investor interest contnues to plague the bourse, hampering liquidity.
Overall, volume increased to 359,662 shares -- mainly through direct trades -- from 138,781 shares traded on Friday, while turnover climbed to 147.93 million crowns, from 11.39 million crowns.
